quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where drivers are not allowed to enter. You may see it on one-way streets or if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards just ahead. This sign warns you of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare to turn or watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a winding road ahead. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell you about traffic laws. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What must you do when you see an octagonal sign?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: You cannot turn right where this sign is posted. It is unsafe and illegal to turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This sign means that:

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers:

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. You must move left to merge with other traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane use control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use the lane it marks.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you do not have the right-of-way. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass before you proceed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. The speed shown on a sign like this tells you the safest speed for the upcoming curve.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. These signs help you drive safely through work zones. Traffic fines may be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in two directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a divided highway is starting. Keep to the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing. You must stop and wait until pedestrians have completely crossed the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leaves the freeway and does not continue through. If you are in this lane, you can change lanes to stay on the freeway, or you must exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangle sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What message is on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully because bicycles often cross or ride beside traffic in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic signal tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Be alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Stop before the crosswalk if there is no stop line. Stop before the intersection if there is no crosswalk. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, you must look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Never try to beat an oncoming train.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge in.
questions.explanation: When driving on a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If the lane next to you is empty, move over.

questions.question: This sign warns you that ahead is:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed. It is a regulatory sign that shows a traffic law you must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other cars or to drive through.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you to prepare for traffic entering from the right side.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows a rule you must obey. This sign means drivers cannot pass other vehicles at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to what is ahead. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way highway and will soon drive on a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what traffic rules you must follow. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are only for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are only for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right and then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs show what is ahead. This sign means the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn to go the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming and you should be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign means traffic from the right will be joining your lane. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill slope is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Get ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is something on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows that the road has a sharp curve in the direction of the arrow (left in this case). You may see several of these signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot turn left. Turning left at this intersection is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep downhill section. Adjust your speed to avoid brake problems or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs show rules that drivers must always obey. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are for buses and vehicles with at least the minimum number of passengers shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many turns or curves.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This yellow sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down and let any trains pass. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign tells you that railroad tracks are ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. Drive carefully through these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that the road curves right first, then curves left. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are always arranged from top to bottom as red, yellow, and green. This yellow sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road work.
The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black marks. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you to slow down and prepare for a sharp turn.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: A round sign marks a railroad crossing. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a winding road with three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must let other traffic go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A traffic control device is ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They give drivers important information about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you about conditions that can make you lose control. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road direction changes or narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road direction changes or narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply or get narrower. You may see several of these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Drive at normal speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: When you reach a railroad crossing, slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop. Let trains pass before you go across.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They warn of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign orders you to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed allowed on this road. In bad weather, rain, snow, or ice, you must drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic laws you must follow. This sign requires you to drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, reduce your speed. Avoid sudden braking or turning. Keep more distance between your vehicle and the one in front.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can safely merge into traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can safely merge into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge onto your road. Check your mirrors and sides. Move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road ahead go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road intersects ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A left turn is allowed only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.
A divided highway is starting. Slow down to the speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right and you should slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph in this case.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane ends soon. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends soon. Merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the number of lanes ahead is decreasing. Traffic must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill or downgrade ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers that they are approaching a construction zone. Slow down and drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to an upcoming curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay on the side indicated by the arrow. An island, median, or barrier is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet. Be extra careful and reduce speed in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid getting a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are bad. Always adjust your speed for weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you to watch for traffic entering from a side road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will curve right and then curve left. Slow down so you can safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You will often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is attached to slow-moving vehicles to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers and riders can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent down at the elbow, it means the driver or rider is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards or special road conditions. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing downward is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see a yield sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A flagger is controlling traffic ahead in a construction area.

questions.question: What is a pentagon-shaped sign?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn drivers about school zones. They alert you to areas where children and pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead. Get ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead. A road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (for example, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you to a traffic signal ahead. Be ready to respond to yellow lights, red lights, or cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a crossroad ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic flows both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones and school crossings. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit near schools.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge is narrow. Be careful when meeting or passing trucks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear to safely cross the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows the direction traffic must flow on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crosswalk.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and other vehicles. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Drive carefully where pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
You will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming. Look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones and school crossings. When you see these signs, stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road goes steeply downhill ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits into two directions. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn you to slow down, drive carefully, and look for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign means a Y intersection is ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. For example, it might show 30 mph.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. When you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let cross traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you. Stop if needed before proceeding.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The road dips steeply where railroad tracks cross. Low vehicles may hit or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean there is work zone activity ahead. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. You must follow their directions.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let other traffic go first.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. When turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that there is low clearance ahead. Tall vehicles may not fit under the bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum vehicle height allowed in this state.
The maximum vehicle width allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign tells you how high the space is under a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches high.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs are bright yellow-green. These signs warn you about road conditions ahead, such as curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle. At night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look in all directions before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means you are turning left. Extend your left arm straight out to the left to signal a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending. Be ready for oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs tell drivers about services available nearby. These include rest areas, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to possible dangers. This sign warns you that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign prohibits U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not align properly.
You may get a flat tire.
You may lose control of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake suddenly or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down means yield. When you see a yield sign, slow down to a safe speed for road conditions. Stop if you need to. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two one-way roads separated by a barrier. You must stay in the right lane.
